card.text: White star in Cepheus, flattened and gravity darkened by its fast spin.

introduction.text: Alderamin spins so fast that its equator swells to 2.74 solar radii while its poles sit at 2.16. It is drawn that shape, 15.0 parsecs away.

color.summary: Measured colour, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
